title: Gender Bias Evaluation in Text-to-image Generation: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying and categorizing methods from recent literature, which include designing prompts (template-based, dataset captions, LLM-generated, and counterfactuals), extracting attributes from generated images (using facial classifiers, VQA, and vision-language embeddings like CLIP), and applying statistical metrics (such as Mean Absolute Deviation, bias scores, and chi-square tests) to measure context-to-gender and gender-to-context biases.
